interval_years.quote: Each license issued under this part shall be issued in accordance with a two-year renewal cycle established by rule.

required.quote: As a condition precedent for license renewal, each licensee shall, during each two-year licensure cycle or other cycle defined by rule, complete 30 hours of qualified continuing professional education in accordance with standards defined by rule.

hours_per_period.quote: complete 30 hours of qualified continuing professional education in accordance with standards defined by rule

available.quote: Subject to Subsections (4) through (7), the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b) the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c) the applicant's license is in good standing in the other state, district, or territory where the license was issued.
available.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 302

requirements.value: Applicant must have been licensed in another state with similar scope of practice, have at least one year of experience under that license, and be in good standing.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee has engaged in unprofessional conduct, as defined by statute or rule under this title
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 401

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unlawful conduct as defined by statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee has engaged in unlawful conduct as defined by statute under this title
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 401

disciplinary_grounds.description: Determined to be mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee has been determined to be mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 401

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance use, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee is unable to practice the occupation or profession with reasonable skill and safety because of illness, drunkenness, excessive use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or other type of material, or as a result of a mental or physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 401

disciplinary_grounds.description: Buying, selling, or fraudulently obtaining any optometry diploma, license, certificate, or registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: buying, selling, or fraudulently obtaining, any optometry diploma, license, certificate, or registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling or providing contact lenses or ophthalmic lenses inconsistently with statutory requirements or intentionally altering a prescription
disciplinary_grounds.quote: selling or providing contact lenses or ophthalmic lenses in a manner inconsistent with Section 58-16a-801 or intentionally altering a prescription unless the person selling or providing the lenses is a licensed optometrist or ophthalmologist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or employing an optometric assistant in a manner not in accordance with professional standards or applicable law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: using or employing the services of an optometric assistant to assist a licensee in any manner not in accordance with: (a) the generally recognized practices and standards of ethics of the profession; or (b) applicable state law or division rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to refer a patient to an appropriate licensed practitioner when needed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to refer a patient to an appropriate licensed practitioner when: (a) the patient's condition does not respond to treatment; or (b) the treatment is not within the scope of competence or licensure of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing confidential patient information to third parties without legal or professional grounds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: providing confidential information regarding a patient to any third party who does not have a legal and professional ground for obtaining the information

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly prescribing, selling, giving away, or administering prescription drugs without legitimate medical purpose or proper diagnosis
disciplinary_grounds.quote: knowingly prescribing, selling, giving away, or administering any prescription drug unless: (a) for a legitimate medical purpose; (b) upon a proper diagnosis indicating the use of the drug in the amount prescribed or provided; and (c) in compliance with Section 58-17b-309

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving or receiving fees, commissions, rebates, or other compensation for professional services not actually rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: giving or receiving directly or indirectly any fee, commission, rebate, or other compensation for professional services not actually and personally rendered, except as part of a legal relationship within a lawful professional partnership, corporation, or association

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to transfer pertinent patient medical records to another optometrist or physician when requested
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to transfer pertinent and necessary information from a patient's medical records to another optometrist or physician when so requested by the patient or his representative, as designated in writing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide a contact lens prescription to a person who sells contact lenses
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to provide a contact lens prescription to a person who sells contact lenses in accordance with Section 58-16a-306

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely making an entry in or altering a medical record to conceal wrongful acts or omissions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: falsely making an entry in, or altering, a medical record with the intent to conceal: (a) a wrongful or negligent act or omission of an individual licensed under this chapter or an individual under the direction or control of an individual licensed under this chapter

definition_quote.value: examination of the human eye and its adnexa to detect and diagnose defects or abnormal conditions; determination or modification of the accommodative or refractive state of the human eye; prescription, ordering, administration, or adaptation of ophthalmic lenses, contact lenses, ophthalmic devices, pharmaceutical agents, laboratory tests, or ocular exercises to diagnose and treat diseases, defects, or other abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa
definition_quote.quote: "Optometry" and "practice of optometry" mean any one or any combination of the following practices: (a) examination of the human eye and its adnexa to detect and diagnose defects or abnormal conditions

value: examination of the human eye and its adnexa
determination or modification of refractive state
prescription, ordering, administration, or adaptation of ophthalmic lenses, contact lenses, pharmaceutical agents, laboratory tests, or ocular exercises
removal of foreign body from the eye or adnexa not deeper than the anterior 1/2 of the cornea
consultation and referral to other health care providers
prescription and administration of pharmaceutical agents including oral agents
methods_authorized.quote: prescription, ordering, administration, or adaptation of ophthalmic lenses, contact lenses, ophthalmic devices, pharmaceutical agents, laboratory tests, or ocular exercises to diagnose and treat diseases, defects, or other abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa

drug_authority.value: May prescribe or administer pharmaceutical agents for the eye and its adnexa, including oral agents; oral antibiotics limited to eyelid-related ocular conditions; hydrocodone combination drugs or Schedule III controlled substances for pain of the eye/adnexa, oral or topical only, up to 72-hour quantity, no refills; may not prescribe Schedule II controlled substances (except hydrocodone combination drugs if so scheduled)
drug_authority.quote: prescribe or administer pharmaceutical agents for the eye and its adnexa, including oral agents, subject to the following conditions: (i) an optometrist may prescribe oral antibiotics for only eyelid related ocular conditions or diseases, and other ocular conditions or diseases specified by division rule

surgery_prohibited.quote: An optometrist may not: (a) perform surgery, including laser surgery

surgery_definition.value: Surgery in which human tissue is cut, burned, or vaporized by means of laser or ionizing radiation (for laser surgery)
surgery_definition.quote: "Laser surgery" means surgery in which human tissue is cut, burned, or vaporized by means of laser or ionizing radiation.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: removal of a foreign body from the eye or its adnexa, that is not deeper than the anterior 1/2 of the cornea

value: May not prescribe or administer Schedule II controlled substances (except hydrocodone combination drugs if so scheduled and meeting criteria)
May prescribe or administer hydrocodone combination drugs or Schedule III controlled substances only for pain of the eye or adnexa, oral or topical, up to 72-hour quantity, no refills
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: An optometrist may not: ... (b) prescribe or administer a Schedule II controlled substance, as defined in Section 58-37-4, except for a hydrocodone combination drug, if so scheduled and prescribed or administered in accordance with Subsection (1)(b).

opioid_prescription_day_limit.quote: the amount of the substance administered or prescribed does not exceed a 72-hour quantity

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: prescribe or administer pharmaceutical agents for the eye and its adnexa, including oral agents

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: An optometrist may: (a) provide optometric services not specifically prohibited under this chapter or division rules if the services are within the optometrist's training, skills, and scope of competence; and (b) prescribe or administer pharmaceutical agents for the eye and its adnexa, including oral agents

referral_to_physician_required.quote: failure to refer a patient to an appropriate licensed practitioner when: (a) the patient's condition does not respond to treatment; or (b) the treatment is not within the scope of competence or licensure of the licensee

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: "Optometric assistant" means an unlicensed individual: (a) working under the direct and immediate supervision of a licensed optometrist; and (b) engaged in specific tasks assigned by the licensed optometrist in accordance with the standards and ethics of the profession.

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: the expiration date of the prescription, which shall be two years from the commencement date, unless documented medical reasons require otherwise.

patient_record_retention_years.quote: he maintains a copy of the patient's contact lens prescription for not less than seven years

criminal_background_check_required.quote: consent to, and complete, a criminal background check, described in Section 58-1-301.5
